retrieved_sources.text:
* **CloudNative Specific**: [how-to-file-effective-incident-jira-tickets-on-the-cloudnative-platform](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-430)

Steps to file JIRA with CloudNative Platform* Click link to file incident with CloudNativeV3:  <https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-476>
* Click link to [**CloudNative Platform Incident (v3)**](https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-210)
* Fillin these Values
	+ Summary - This is a Summary of the incident ... Example: Pod ABCDEFGHI failed to deploy CloudNative Environment due to okeinfra issue
	+ Fleet - The name of the CloudNative V3 Fleet ... This information can be found in the PipelineHub UI as the attribute "Fleet"
	+ Environment Name - This is the same as the POD Name (otherwise known as the System Name in the DevOps Portal
	+ Impact Start Time - Click on the Clock icon and supply a value, usually use the current time
	+ Description - Supply a Description of the issue (what steps did you perform to self-triage the issue and determine issue needs to be filed with CloudNative Platform)
	+ Press the CREATE button to submit the incident

retrieved_sources.text:
| CloudNative | Many CloudNative related issues during platforms are specific to a particular  CloudNative service. In these cases, please file with the CloudNative Service JIRA Project using JIRA Board from the CloudNative Taxonomy for the service, Since so many services, won't list each link here, use Taxonomy to locate Jira Board.If issue impacts all services: [File Incident for CloudNative Platform](https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-473) If issue only affects services on EnvironmentService, use ENVIRONMENT_INTEGRATION > CloudNative**APM** Issues - Please read these links before filing JIRAs:* [CloudPlatform+Application+Preflight+and+Promotion+-for+AppPackages](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-474)
* [APM+Troubleshooting+Guide](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-371)
* Create Issue in [SAASINFRA](https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-475) and post in #ris-dataservice-env-support channel
